description_en: The Clock Royal Tower (Center for Crescent Observation and Astronomy) The Astronomy Museum consists of four floors: First Floor: Showcases everything related to the Makkah Clock, including its construction and timekeeping technologies. There is also a balcony providing a view of the Holy Kaaba. Second Floor: Focuses on everything related to time measurement, human innovations, and documentation of human efforts to comprehend time. Third Floor: Dedicated to the sun, earth, the moon, and all associated elements. Fourth Floor: Designated for observing all aspects related to the universe as a whole, including stars, constellations, and astronomical occurrences. Center for Crescent Observation: The Center for Crescent Observation occupies seven floors at the top of the Clock Royal Tower in Makkah: First Floor: Lobby (Reception hall and administrative offices) Second Floor: Crescent Library Third Floor: Crescent Gallery (Phases of the Moon) Fourth Floor: Research departments (Prayer Times Center, Qibla Direction) Fifth Floor: Crescent Committee Sixth Floor: Prayer hall Seventh Floor: Tower Peak Lounge Makkah Observatory

title_en: The Cultural Front of Umm Al-Qura University
description_en: The Cultural Front Building of Umm Al-Qura University is located at its main campus in the Al-Abdiyyah neighborhood, within the university campus. It serves as an integrated cultural center that includes the contents of the Umm Al-Qura University Museum, which were transferred from the university's headquarters in the Al-Aziziyah neighborhood, and it includes the contents of the Manuscripts Museum, which were transferred from the King Abdullah University Library. The building contains several exhibitions that contribute to highlighting the role of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in developing higher education and highlighting the role of Umm Al-Qura University in preserving the history of Makkah Al-Mukarramah by displaying artifacts, manuscripts, and historical photographs of the city of Makkah Al-Mukarramah. The building also reflects the local culture of the city of Makkah Al-Mukarramah through its exterior design and through the Makkah Gallery and the Makkah Center Gallery. It also contains a cultural square that contains the latest display technologies and provides a place to hold discussions and dialogue sessions.

title_en: King Abdulaziz Complex for Holy Kaaba Kiswa
title_ar: مجمع الملك عبد العزيز للكسوة المشرفة
description_en: In mid-1346 AH, King Abdul-Aziz bin Abdul-Rahman Al Saud (may Allah have mercy on him) issued an order to establish a dedicated facility for producing the Kiswa (cover) of the Kaaba. The factory’s development continued until it was renovated and modernized, and reopened in 1397 AH. Departments of the Complex: The complex comprises several departments, the most important of which are: Belt Department Sewing Department Dyeing Department Printing Department Mechanical Weaving Department Hand Weaving Department Laboratory Department More than 200 qualified and trained Saudi workers operate in these departments. Alongside producing the Kiswa of the Holy Kaaba annually, the complex also manufactures the inner Kiswa of the Kaaba, the inner Kiswa of the Sacred Prophet’s Chamber, and the flag of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, embroidered and printed in accordance with the Law of the Flag of the Kingdom. Visiting Hours: The complex welcomes Muslim visitors for a unique learning experience in weaving and embroidering the Kaaba’s Kiswa
description_ar: في منتصف عام 1346هـ أصدر الملك عبد العزيز بن عبد الرحمن آل سعود يرحمه الله أمرًا بإنشاء دار خاصة لصناعة كسوة الكعبة. واستمر العمل في إنشاء مصنع كسوة الكعبة المشرفة إلى أن تم تجديد المصنع وتحديثه وافتتح في عـــام1397هـ. أقسام المجمع: يحتوي المجمع على عدة أقسام من أهم هذه الأقسام: 1. قسم الحزام 2. قسم خياطة الثوب 3. قسم المصبغة 4. قسم الطباعة 5. قسم النسيج الآلي 6. قسم النسيج اليدوي 7. قسم المختبر ويعمل في تلك الأقسام أكثر من مائتي عامل من العمالة السعودية المؤهلة والمدربة. وبالإضافة إلى إنتاج كسوة الكعبة المشرفة كل عام فإن المجمع ينتج أيضًا الكسوة الداخلية للكعبة المشرفة والكسوة الداخلية للحجرة النبوية الشريفة وعلم المملكة العربية السعودية مطرزًا ومطبوعاً طبقاٌ لنظام علم المملكة العربية السعودية. أوقات الزيارة: يرحب المجمع بزواره من المسلمين والمسلمات لخوض تجربة معرفية فريدة بين حياكة كسوة الكعبة وتطريزها

title_en: The library of the Grand Mosque
description_en:
The Library of the Grand Mosque in Makkah is one of the city’s prominent scientific and cultural landmarks. Its establishment dates back to 161 AH. Originally located within the Grand Mosque, the library was later relocated outside the المسجد الحرام as its collections expanded over time. It is currently situated in the Batha Quraysh district and operates under the supervision of the General Authority for the Care of the Affairs of the Grand Mosque and the Prophet’s Mosque.
The library houses more than 8,305 manuscripts, including approximately 2,000 digitized manuscripts. It also preserves rare historical photographs of the Two Holy Mosques dating back to 1279 AH. In addition, the library holds around 78,000 titles and a collection exceeding 200,000 books.
description_ar: تعتبر مكتبة الحرم المكي الشريف أحد الصروح العلمية الثقافية بمكة المكرمة ويعود تاريخ انشاءها الى العام 161هـ، كان موقعها سابقاً داخل المسجد الحرام وبمرور الأيام وتوسع المكتبة انتقلت الى خارج المسجد الحرام، وتقع حالياً في حي بطحاء قريش تحت إشراف هيئة العناية بشؤون المسجد الحرام والمسجد النبوي، حيث تحتوي المكتبة على أكثر من8305 مخطوطة، منها 2000مخطوطة مصورة كما تحتوي المكتبة على صور نادرة للحرمين الشريفين منذ العام ١٢٧٩هـ، ويوجد بالمكتبة 78000 عنوان وأكثر من ٢٠٠ ألف كتاب.

The museum features numerous archaeological artifacts, heritage items, traditional tools, and various historic vehicles. It is organized into several sections, including the Great Conquest Section (featuring a simulation of Al-Hudaybiyyah Well), the Al-Hudaybiyyah Mosque Simulation Section, the Founder King Abdulaziz Well Section, the Al-Mudai Market Simulation Section, the Dates Corner, the Collectibles Section, and several other thematic areas.
